title: Robust Dual-Regularized Variable Selection under Outlier Contamination
abstract: arXiv:2609.21342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real data often contain unusual observations that can exert disproportionate effects on variable selection, especially in complex predictor settings. We propose a two-stage {\it sparse median outer product of gradients (smOPG)} method for variable selection in single index models with outlier contamination. We first estimate sparse local gradients via \(\ell_1\)-penalized local median regression and then recover the active predictor set from a rank-one sparse approximation of the resulting gradient matrix using regularized singular value decomposition. The combination of median regression and local weighting provides robustness to both response outliers and leverage points. Extensive simulations across varying dimensions and contamination mechanisms demonstrate the favorable variable selection performance of smOPG relative to existing methods. translated_title: 离群点污染下的稳健双重正则化变量选择
translated_abstract: 实际数据中常常包含异常观测值，这些异常值可能对变量选择产生不成比例的影响，尤其是在复杂的预测变量场景中。我们提出了一种两阶段的稀疏中位数梯度外积方法，用于含离群点污染的单指标模型中的变量选择。该方法首先通过 ℓ1 惩罚的局部中位数回归估计稀疏局部梯度，然后利用正则化奇异值分解，从所得梯度矩阵的秩一稀疏近似中恢复活跃预测变量集合。中位数回归与局部加权的结合，使该方法对响应离群点和杠杆点均具有稳健性。在不同维度和多种污染机制下的大量模拟研究表明，smOPG 相较于现有方法具有更优的变量选择性能。在空气污染和基因组数据上的应用展示了其实用价值，理论方面……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出了一种两阶段稀疏中位数梯度外积（smOPG）方法，通过 ℓ1 惩罚局部中位数回归与正则化奇异值分解相结合，实现对含离群点的单指标模型同时抵御响应离群点和杠杆点的稳健变量选择。
en_tdlr: A two-stage sparse median outer product of gradients (smOPG) method is proposed for robust variable selection in single-index models under outlier contamination, combining ℓ1-penalized local median regression with regularized singular value decomposition to achieve robustness against both response outliers and leverage points.
